statusText: Mapped policy state: STRONG_BLOCK_NO_NEW_RISK. NQ remains near the lower quarter of the session range with downside technical structure and aligned rates, oil and technology breadth pressure.
recommendation: High Tail reflects observed downside persistence with only a shallow recovery from the session low. Deeper retracements and two-way rotation would support de-escalation.
headline: NQ remains downside-efficient ahead of the cash open, while the rebound from the low keeps Tail below critical.
body: At cutoff, NQ was about 30,455 within a roughly 30,370-30,714 range. Technicals remained Strong Sell. Claims were 197k versus 201k expected. Fresh Finviz latest-session megacap and semiconductor breadth was uniformly negative.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low/watch overnight to high as September 24 downside efficiency persisted; published history is preserved without hindsight.
outlookSummary: Tail remains high but below critical after a shallow rebound from the low. Cash-open structure, housing data and Paulson remarks are the immediate checkpoints; later risk depends on realized retracement quality.

forecast.analysis: Observed NQ near 30,455 sits in the lower quarter of the session range after a shallow rebound from 30,370. Strong Sell technicals and aligned breadth keep Tail high, while the rebound keeps it below critical.
drivers: NQ remains near the lower quarter of the session range

forecast.analysis: High Tail at 16:00 UTC requires the opening decline to remain unresolved. Wider rotations or repaired breadth would support de-escalation.
Elevated Tail at 17:00 UTC assumes residual trend persistence. Full retracements of new lows or a stable range would indicate improving mean reversion.
Elevated Tail at 18:00 UTC depends on session-extreme holding or another failed rebound. Range re-entry would support further normalization.
At 19:00 UTC, elevated Tail requires renewed extension with weak pullbacks. Balanced swings would point toward the watch band.
At 20:00 UTC, watch Tail reflects residual late-session continuation risk. Meaningful counter-moves would favor normalization.
At 21:00 UTC, watch risk persists only if the U.S. session remains directionally efficient. Two-way closing trade would reduce it.
At 22:00 UTC, low Tail assumes no fresh one-way leg. Any late shock would need observed continuation, not headline importance alone, to reverse normalization.
drivers: Any new geopolitical or rates shock

forecast.analysis: At 23:00 UTC, low Tail assumes the main U.S. catalyst window passes without persistent late extension. New information would be judged from the resulting price path.
At 00:00 UTC, low Tail reflects an overnight normalization baseline. Thin-liquidity moves alone would not raise Tail without persistence.
At 01:00 UTC, low Tail remains the base case. A sustained overnight break with shallow retracements would be the main escalation signal.
At 02:00 UTC, low Tail assumes orderly Asian-hours rotation. Successive directional extensions, not volatility alone, would raise concern.
At 03:00 UTC, low Tail continues unless Asia develops a one-way move with failed counter-swings and cross-asset confirmation.
At 04:00 UTC, low Tail reflects a pre-Europe baseline. Repeated extension with weak retracements would be required for material escalation.
At 05:00 UTC, low Tail remains the base case. Yields, oil and technology breadth matter more if NQ also becomes directionally efficient.
drivers: Yields and oil only if NQ confirms

forecast.analysis: At 06:00 UTC, watch Tail reflects the European handoff. A directional break holding near an extreme could lift risk; range re-entry would lower it.
At 07:00 UTC, watch risk depends on whether European flows reinforce or reverse the overnight direction. Failed retracements would be the key warning.
At 08:00 UTC, watch Tail assumes no observed one-way U.S. premarket path yet. Cross-asset alignment would need fresh NQ confirmation.
At 09:00 UTC, watch Tail reflects growing pre-U.S. sensitivity. Repeated rejection of counter-swings would matter more than event importance alone.
At 10:00 UTC, watch Tail stays below the block threshold absent observed pre-release persistence. A stable range would keep path risk contained.
At 11:00 UTC, elevated Tail is conditional on pre-Durable-Goods positioning becoming one-way. Balanced trade would keep most risk in Stress.
At 12:00 UTC, Durable Goods at 12:30 is the main checkpoint. Tail reaches 30% only if the observed post-release path becomes persistent with shallow or failed retracements.

forecastDetail.comment: Current high Tail is supported by persistent downside structure, but the rebound off the low keeps the state below critical.
The cash open is a conditional path test: renewed extension and shallow rebounds would sustain high Tail; absorption would weaken it.
Post-housing and Paulson risk stays high only if the realized price path remains one-way with weak retracements.
High Tail at 16:00 UTC requires the opening decline to remain unresolved; broader rotation would support de-escalation.
Elevated Tail at 17:00 UTC assumes some residual trend persistence, not an automatic continuation of the morning move.
Elevated Tail at 18:00 UTC depends on continued extreme holding or another failed rebound; balanced trade would reduce it.
